name: notes-search-ui
comment: React, ReactDOM, lucide-react and @kirocrew/app-sdk are supplied by the dashboard host through its import map, so they are Rollup externals rather than dependencies: a second React would break every hook. marked and DOMPurify are bundled: the host's MarkdownRenderer cannot resolve [[wikilinks]], rewrite embedded images or give headings stable ids for the outline, and every note passes through DOMPurify because clipped web pages in the vault carry raw HTML into a page that runs with the dashboard's credentials.
